subject: Phased retention exception & BYO-KMS: playbook + sprint asks
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@healthsync.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance-team@healthsync.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-window retention for pilot (BYOK+KMS notes)

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As discussed, HealthSync will be running a 6-week pilot that ingests sensitive patient-provided notes. We need a temporary retention window of 48 hours for the raw transcript payloads before redaction, after which sanitized records can be kept longer. The ask in short: a short-term exception for a pilot (48h raw retention), BYOK encryption for data at rest, and a proof of audit logs showing ingestion and redaction events.

Attached is a one-page request and a CSV mapping sample identifiers to fields we consider PHI. We understand this is an exception to your default retention model — this is timeboxed and we will sign a Data Processing Appendix.

Key constraints from our side:
- Must use our KMS key (key rotation allowed but not re-wrapping without our consent)
- Audit records for every ingestion, transformation (redaction), and delete event — retained for 90 days
- Ability to extract an evidence pack for SOC-type review within 48 hours of request

Can you confirm what your cross-functional triage looks like and whether you can support a phased implementation? We are flexible on a canary approach.

Thanks,
Sarah Liu
Head of Compliance, HealthSync
---
Attachment: HealthSync_retention_request.pdf (application/pdf, 98KB)
Attachment: pilot-data-map.csv (text/csv, 4KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: short-window retention for pilot (BYOK+KMS notes)

Forwarding HealthSync's formal ask — they want a 48h raw retention exception, BYOK, and an auditable evidence pack.

Irene / Tessa / Priyom — can you triage this and propose a minimal, low-risk playbook we can commit to within two weeks? Things to include: product gating (what features we must enable/disable), operational checklists (KMS handoff, key grant flow, rotation policy), audit-log schema for ingestion/redaction/delete events, and an SLA for evidence extraction. Naomi, can you own the compliance acceptance criteria?

Quick notes from my side:
- We should prefer a phased delivery: 1) enable BYOK and scoped KMS grant; 2) wire audit-event emission + short-term storage (48h TTL) in a protected bucket; 3) provide extraction tooling for evidence packs.
- Product needs to tell us whether a 48h TTL can be implemented purely via metadata/automatic deletion or whether we need infra-level eviction. If infra eviction required, list roll-out risks.
- Engineering ETA asked: should target a small alpha with HealthSync in 12 business days if feasible.

Assigning: Irene (ops/playbook draft), Tessa (implementation constraints + ETA), Priyom (telemetry/audit schema). Please reply with a one-page plan by end of day tomorrow.

Thanks — Marcus
Senior PM, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short-window retention for pilot (BYOK+KMS notes)

Marcus / team —

I put together a draft phased playbook (high level) inline below. This is intentionally minimal so we can meet the 12-business-day alpha target. Comments welcome.

PHASE 0 — Triage & Agreement (0–2 business days)
- Confirm legal DPA addendum and pilot window (HealthSync to sign)
- Confirm external KMS key ARN and required roles/grants (HealthSync to provide)
- Define evidence scope (list of events + retention period = 90 days for audit logs)

PHASE 1 — BYOK + Access Grants (2–6 business days)
- Accept HealthSync KMS key via our BYOK onboarding (document required: key_policy.json)
- Create scoped IAM role for ingest pipeline with explicit ReEncrypt/Decrypt allowed using their key; record role creation event in audit log
- Provide HealthSync with test key-grant summary and request minimal rotation schedule agreement

PHASE 2 — Short-window retention + Delete Flow (4–10 business days)
- Implement 48h TTL on raw payloads: preferred approach is metadata-driven lifecycle that triggers a delete job. If existing object-lifecycle rules suffice, use those; otherwise add infra job.
- Emit audit events for: ingestion (ingest_id, timestamp, user/service), redaction applied (redaction_id, ruleset, timestamp), delete confirmation (delete_id, timestamp)
- Ensure events are immutably written to an append-only audit topic (retained 90 days)

PHASE 3 — Evidence extraction & Handoff (8–12 business days)
- Provide tooling (script + Drive link) that exports requested event subset and sample sanitized records into an encrypted bundle for HealthSync.
- Run a dry-run with HealthSync to validate structure and timing (aim: extraction within 48 hours of request)

Risks & Open Questions
- KMS key policy nuances: re-wrapping vs re-encryption during rotation — we need HealthSync policy confirmation
- If TTL requires infra-level eviction, rollback plan and capacity to avoid accidental deletes for other tenants is required
- Audit event schema: Priyom to propose minimal fields. We need to ensure PII is not leaked in audit events.

I can own the playbook doc and the compliance checklist. I'll drop a Google Drive draft link by EOD.

-Irene
Sr Security PM

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short-window retention for pilot (BYOK+KMS notes)

Thanks — quick implementation notes from infra/engineering:

1) BYOK onboarding path: we have a lightweight flow for customer KMS ARNs that we can use. Work: create grant + allow re-encrypt/decrypt for the ingest service. Estimate: 2 engineer-days to wire grant and test in staging.

2) 48h TTL: two possible approaches
  - Object lifecycle rule on a customer-scoped bucket (no code change) — lowest risk; depends on bucket isolation for pilot.
  - Scheduled eviction job that deletes by metadata tag — requires ~3 engineer-days and careful tenancy checks.
We recommend lifecycle rule for the pilot if HealthSync is ok with a scoped ingestion path (logical separation).

3) Audit events: we can emit ingestion/redaction/delete events to our existing append-only telemetry topic. Priyom — please confirm minimal schema. We will keep events minimal and redact any PHI fields.

4) Evidence pack: we can assemble an encrypted archive. ETA for alpha (end-to-end dry-run) = 12 business days if we get the signed DPA and KMS ARN by EOD next Monday. If either slips, add 5 business days.

Action items:
- HealthSync: sign pilot DPA + provide KMS key ARN (blocked)
- Priyom: propose telemetry schema (by EOD today)
- Irene: share playbook doc link when ready
- Marcus / Naomi: I'll need compliance acceptance signoff to proceed to production-like access

Tessa
Lead, Platform Security Ops

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short-window retention for pilot (BYOK+KMS notes)

Thanks team — signed off on the proposed minimal acceptance criteria. Two clarifications from Compliance:

1) Evidence pack contents: must include an event-index (CSV) with ingest_id/redaction_id/delete_id + timestamps and HMACs for each line to verify integrity. We will not accept audit logs that include raw PHI fields.

2) KMS rotation: HealthSync must declare a rotation window (e.g., 90 days) and whether they require immediate re-wrapping on rotation events. If they require re-wrapping, we need to schedule a separate validation effort (risk: bulk re-encrypt could be disruptive).

I'll prepare the minimal acceptance checklist and drop it into Irene's Drive folder. Once Priyom posts the telemetry schema and HealthSync provides the KMS ARN + signed DPA, Tessa's team can start.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Compliance
Redwood Inference
